reason: Magnesium sounds sensible but I have never bought it and a brand with no reviews is asking me to pay now for something that ships in January. I would want to see whether anyone has actually felt a difference before I hand over money.
objection: Does it actually do anything for tiredness, or is the magnesium just a small amount in a sweet? Two gummies a day for a new brand with no track record is a lot of faith to put in.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews from women my age saying they noticed less tiredness after a month, plus a shipping date I can rely on.
